rows.en: I'm expecting a lot from you.
Count on me, okay?
I'd protect you... but you don't need it.
Let's do this! There's no way we can't!
I'm counting on you.
How are you feeling? I'm counting on you.
Don't fall for my skills, miss.
I'll do my best to be useful!
Heh, a date in the sky isn't bad either.
Burn! More! Be more passionate!
Rely on me too, okay?
Show me what a girl like you can do.
You can leave it all to me.
We'll surely succeed!
Gotta show you my good side a little.
Man, teaming with you is irresistible!
Come on, let's show them the power of women!
I'll show them a woman's pride.
No one can stop us!
I'll protect you! Just kidding.
Now then, leave the escort to me.
Your passion and mine. Even I can't predict what'll happen.
Time to show our teamwork.
Relax. I'll guard your back.
I can entrust my life to you without worry.
Leave support to me. Fight with peace of mind.
With you, success is guaranteed! Let's get this done!
I won't forgive anyone who hurts you! Bring it on!
I'll support you properly. Don't worry.
Come back alive. I hate being lonely.
Together we're invincible. You think so too, right?
Phew. Somehow it's over.
Geez, I'd only like to be with a woman on a date.
Pathetic. Really pathetic.
Next time I'd like someone else.
From now on, I'm working alone.
I can't believe even I have someone I can't stand.
Felt harder than usual somehow.
Same old bad luck.
rows.notes: 'Itsumo no baitsukaru' is garbled; guesses: batsu game or binbou-kuji (short straw). Rendered loosely.

rows.en: I can't do this! The duo's done! Disbanded!
Hmm... I can't disobey orders, but...
I believe I told you not to do anything unnecessary.
Let's call it quits, you and me.
Let's try a bit harder.
I'd have had it easier alone.
It's a wonder you made it back alive. Thank your parents for making you sturdy.
I wish they'd let me sortie alone.
Typical of a little girl.
I'm tired... First time in my life I've been so careful with someone.
Well, let's head back.
Well, time to head back.
Guts, guts. That's what you lack right now. Get it?
It's over. Good work.
Seems you're safe. Heading back.
Mission's done. Shall we return?
Glad we're both safe.
And that's a wrap.
You did well. Still not on my level, though.
Looking forward to the next mission, too.
Heh, good work.
Yeah! Mission complete!
Let's work together next mission, too.
You okay? Never mind, no need to ask.
I'm here. This was a piece of cake.
Glad we're both safe.
Let's rest up for the next one.
Keep up the good work, my friend.
Um, did I show a bit of manliness?
All done safely. Count on you again.
Perfect. Nothing else to say.
Was my support useful?
Good skill for a little girl.
Well done! You get a gold star!
Are you hurt? I was a bit worried.
So how about my skills? Don't fall for me.
I felt it! Your passion!
That move was amazing! I'll learn from it!
Done already? That was quick today.
Yay! Pretty nice skills!
Sortie with me again, okay?
